import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = len(s)
    out = [s[0]]
    replaced_at = False
    i = 1
    while i < n:
        if i + 3 < n and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            out.append('.')
            i += 3
        elif i + 1 < n and s[i:i+2] == "at" and not replaced_at:
            out.append('@')
            replaced_at = True
            i += 2
        else:
            out.append(s[i])
            i += 1
    sys.stdout.write(''.join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
